    function renderTournamentMatches(status) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.td-pill').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
      document.getElementById('tdPill-' + status).classList.add('active');

      let container = document.getElementById('tdMatchesContainer');
      let t = currentViewingTournament;
      if (!t) return;

      let filteredMatches = [];
      let matches = t.matches || [];

      if (status === 'live') {
        // Truly live: has live status AND (has a "LIVE" result OR has toss info) AND no final result
        filteredMatches = matches.filter(m => (m.status === "live" || m.status === "Live") && (m.result === "LIVE" || (m.tossInfo && !m.result)));
      } else if (status === 'completed') {
        // Completed: has finished status OR has a non-LIVE result
        filteredMatches = matches.filter(m => m.status === "finished" || m.status === "completed" || (m.result && m.result !== "LIVE" && m.result.trim() !== ""));
      } else if (status === 'upcoming') {
        // Upcoming: strictly matches the Organizer's view (excludes 'live' status entirely)
        filteredMatches = matches.filter(m => (m.status === "upcoming" || !m.status || m.status === "scheduled") && (!m.result || m.result.trim() === ""));
      }

      if (filteredMatches.length === 0) {
        let textMsg = "";
        if (status === 'live') textMsg = `No live matches for ${t.name} at the moment. Check upcoming fixtures or past results.`;
        if (status === 'upcoming') textMsg = `No upcoming matches for ${t.name} right now. Check live or past matches.`;
        if (status === 'completed') textMsg = `No completed matches for ${t.name} right now.`;

        container.innerHTML = `
          <div class="td-empty-state">
            <div class="td-empty-img">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19 3H5c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h14c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V5c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2zm0 16H5V5h14v14zm-5.04-6.71l-2.75 3.54-1.96-2.36L6.5 17h11l-3.54-4.71z"/></svg>
            </div>
            <div class="td-empty-text">${textMsg}</div>
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      let html = '<div class="td-matches-grid">';
      filteredMatches.forEach(m => {
        let badgeClass = status === 'live' ? 'my-badge my-badge-live' : (status === 'completed' ? 'my-badge my-badge-past' : 'my-badge my-badge-soon');
        let badgeText = status === 'live' ? 'LIVE' : (status === 'completed' ? 'PAST' : 'SOON');
        let resText = m.result ? m.result : (m.tossInfo ? m.tossInfo : 'Upcoming match scheduled');

        // Extract score if available
        let s1 = m.score1 || m.t1_score || "";
        let s2 = m.score2 || m.t2_score || "";
        let ov1 = m.overs1 || m.t1_overs || "";
        let ov2 = m.overs2 || m.t2_overs || "";

        html += `
          <div class="my-card" onclick="openTournamentMatchScorecard('${t.id}', '${m.id}', '${m.status}')" style="cursor:pointer; margin:0;">
            <div class="my-card-header">
              <span>${t.name}</span>
              <span class="${badgeClass}">${badgeText}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="my-card-meta">
              ${[t.ground, t.city].filter(Boolean).join(', ')}, ${m.date ? new Date(m.date).toLocaleDateString('en-GB') : ''}, ${t.overs || 20} Ov.
            </div>
            <div class="my-card-bold">League Match</div>
            <div class="my-card-teams">
              <div class="my-card-team-row">
                <span class="my-card-team-name">${m.team1}</span>
                ${s1 ? `<span class="my-card-score">${s1} <span class="my-card-overs">(${ov1})</span></span>` : ''}
              </div>
              <div class="my-card-team-row">
                <span class="my-card-team-name">${m.team2}</span>
                ${s2 ? `<span class="my-card-score">${s2} <span class="my-card-overs">(${ov2})</span></span>` : (m.result ? '' : '<span style="font-size:13px; color:#6b7280; font-weight:500;">Yet to bat</span>')}
              </div>
            </div>

    async function renderTdPointsTable() {
      let t = currentViewingTournament;
      if (!t) return;
      let container = document.getElementById('tdPointsTableContainer');
      container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center; padding:40px; color:#6ee7b7;">⏳ Calculating Standings...</div>`;

      // Fetch all matches for this tournament to get fresh scores
      let tournamentMatches = [];
      try {
        const res = await fetch(API + "/tournament-matches/" + t.id + "?_t=" + Date.now());
        tournamentMatches = await res.json();
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("Failed to fetch tournament matches for points table:", e);
        tournamentMatches = t.matches || [];
      }

      let teamStats = {};
      (t.teams || []).forEach(team => {
        teamStats[team.name] = { M: 0, W: 0, L: 0, Pts: 0, runsScored: 0, oversFaced: 0, runsConceded: 0, oversBowled: 0, nrr: 0 };
      });

      const finishedMatches = tournamentMatches.filter(m => m.status === 'finished' || (m.result && m.result !== 'LIVE'));

      finishedMatches.forEach(m => {
        // Find winner/loser from result string or scores if possible
        let winner = "", loser = "";
        let winnerMatch = (m.result || "").match(/^(.+?) won/);
        if (winnerMatch) {
          winner = winnerMatch[1].trim();
          loser = (winner === m.team1) ? m.team2 : m.team1;
        } else {
          // Fallback if result string is missing but scores exist
          let s1 = parseInt(m.score1) || 0;
          let s2 = parseInt(m.score2) || 0;
          if (s1 > s2) { winner = m.team1; loser = m.team2; }
          else if (s2 > s1) { winner = m.team2; loser = m.team1; }
          else return; // Skip if no clear result
        }

        let mWinner = winner.toLowerCase().trim();
        let mLoser = loser.toLowerCase().trim();

        // Find correct keys in teamStats (case-insensitive)
        let winnerKey = Object.keys(teamStats).find(k => k.toLowerCase().trim() === mWinner);
        let loserKey = Object.keys(teamStats).find(k => k.toLowerCase().trim() === mLoser);

        if (!winnerKey) { teamStats[winner] = { M: 0, W: 0, L: 0, Pts: 0, runsScored: 0, oversFaced: 0, runsConceded: 0, oversBowled: 0, nrr: 0 }; winnerKey = winner; }
        if (!loserKey) { teamStats[loser] = { M: 0, W: 0, L: 0, Pts: 0, runsScored: 0, oversFaced: 0, runsConceded: 0, oversBowled: 0, nrr: 0 }; loserKey = loser; }

        teamStats[winnerKey].M++; teamStats[winnerKey].W++; teamStats[winnerKey].Pts += 2;
        teamStats[loserKey].M++; teamStats[loserKey].L++;

        // NRR Calculation Data from Joined SQL
        let r1 = parseInt(m.t1_score) || 0;
        let r2 = parseInt(m.t2_score) || 0;
        let ov1 = parseFloat(m.t1_overs) || 0;
        let ov2 = parseFloat(m.t2_overs) || 0;

        // Map runs to correct teams based on batting order (t1_name is the team that batted first)
        let t1NameLower = (m.t1_name || "").toLowerCase().trim();
        if (mWinner === t1NameLower) {
          teamStats[winnerKey].runsScored += r1; teamStats[winnerKey].oversFaced += ov1;
          teamStats[winnerKey].runsConceded += r2; teamStats[winnerKey].oversBowled += ov2;
          teamStats[loserKey].runsScored += r2; teamStats[loserKey].oversFaced += ov2;
          teamStats[loserKey].runsConceded += r1; teamStats[loserKey].oversBowled += ov1;
        } else {
          teamStats[winnerKey].runsScored += r2; teamStats[winnerKey].oversFaced += ov2;
          teamStats[winnerKey].runsConceded += r1; teamStats[winnerKey].oversBowled += ov1;
          teamStats[loserKey].runsScored += r1; teamStats[loserKey].oversFaced += ov1;
          teamStats[loserKey].runsConceded += r2; teamStats[loserKey].oversBowled += ov2;
        }
      });

      // Calculate final NRR
      Object.keys(teamStats).forEach(name => {
        let s = teamStats[name];
        function toBalls(ov) { return Math.floor(ov) * 6 + Math.round((ov % 1) * 10); }
        let bFaced = toBalls(s.oversFaced);
        let bBowled = toBalls(s.oversBowled);

        let rrScored = bFaced > 0 ? (s.runsScored / (bFaced / 6)) : 0;
        let rrConceded = bBowled > 0 ? (s.runsConceded / (bBowled / 6)) : 0;
        s.nrr = (rrScored - rrConceded).toFixed(3);
      });

      let rows = Object.entries(teamStats).sort((a, b) => b[1].Pts - a[1].Pts || parseFloat(b[1].nrr) - parseFloat(a[1].nrr));

      if (rows.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="td-empty-state"><div class="td-empty-text">No data yet for the points table.</div></div>`;
        return;
      }

      let html = `
        <div style="background:rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);">
          <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; text-align:left;">
            <thead>
              <tr style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">
                <th style="padding:16px; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; color:#94a3b8; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:1px;">Pos</th>
                <th style="padding:16px; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; color:#94a3b8; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:1px;">Team</th>
                <th style="padding:16px; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; color:#94a3b8; text-align:center;">P</th>
                <th style="padding:16px; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; color:#94a3b8; text-align:center;">W</th>
                <th style="padding:16px; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; color:#94a3b8; text-align:center;">L</th>
                <th style="padding:16px; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; color:#94a3b8; text-align:center;">NRR</th>
                <th style="padding:16px; font-size:12px; font-weight:800; color:#94a3b8; text-align:center;">Pts</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              ${rows.map(([name, s], i) => `
                <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03); ${i < 4 ? 'background:rgba(110,231,183,0.02);' : ''}">
                  <td style="padding:16px; color:#94a3b8; font-weight:700;">${i + 1}</td>
                  <td style="padding:16px;">
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
                      <div style="width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:50%; background:linear-gradient(135deg, #6ee7b7, #3b82f6); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:10px; color:#fff; font-weight:900;">${name.charAt(0)}</div>
                      <span style="color:#f8fafc; font-weight:700;">${name} ${i === 0 ? '👑' : ''}</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td style="padding:16px; color:#cbd5e1; text-align:center;">${s.M}</td>
                  <td style="padding:16px; color:#6ee7b7; font-weight:700; text-align:center;">${s.W}</td>
                  <td style="padding:16px; color:#f43f5e; font-weight:700; text-align:center;">${s.L}</td>
                  <td style="padding:16px; color:#94a3b8; text-align:center; font-size:13px;">${s.nrr > 0 ? '+' : ''}${s.nrr}</td>
                  <td style="padding:16px; color:#6ee7b7; font-weight:900; text-align:center; font-size:16px;">${s.Pts}</td>
                </tr>
              `).join('')}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      `;
      container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function addTournamentOvers(ov1, ov2) {
      let b1 = Math.floor(ov1) * 6 + Math.round((ov1 % 1) * 10);
      let b2 = Math.floor(ov2) * 6 + Math.round((ov2 % 1) * 10);
      let totalBalls = b1 + b2;
      return Math.floor(totalBalls / 6) + (totalBalls % 6) / 10;
    }

      let tournamentMatches = [];
      if (window.fbGetDocs) {
        const q = window.fbQuery(
          window.fbCollection(window.fbDb, "live_matches"),
          window.fbWhere("tournamentId", "==", currentViewingTournamentId)

        );
        try {
          const snap = await window.fbGetDocs(q);
          snap.forEach(doc => tournamentMatches.push(doc.data()));
        } catch (e) { console.error("Firebase fetch error:", e); }
      }

      // Fallback to local matches if Firebase empty (might not have full stats)
      if (tournamentMatches.length === 0) {
        tournamentMatches = (t.matches || []).filter(m => m.batsmen || m.innings1);
      }

      if (tournamentMatches.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="td-empty-state"><div class="td-empty-text">No match data found for this tournament yet. Make sure matches are finished or live in the app.</div></div>`;
        return;
      }

      // Map player names to their actual tournament teams
      let playerRealTeams = {};
      (t.teams || []).forEach(team => {
        (team.players || []).forEach(p => {
          playerRealTeams[p.name] = team.name;
        });
      });

      tournamentMatches.forEach(m => {
        const processInning = (batsmen, bowlers, batTeam, bowlTeam) => {
          (batsmen || []).forEach(b => {
            if (!players[b.name]) players[b.name] = {
              name: b.name, team: playerRealTeams[b.name] || batTeam,
              bat: { runs: 0, balls: 0, inn: 0, outs: 0, fours: 0, sixes: 0 },
              bowl: { wickets: 0, runs: 0, overs: 0, maidens: 0, inn: 0 },
              field: { catches: 0, runouts: 0, stumpings: 0 },
              pts: 0
            };
            let p = players[b.name];
            p.bat.inn++;
            p.bat.runs += parseInt(b.runs) || 0;
            p.bat.balls += parseInt(b.balls) || 0;
            p.bat.fours += parseInt(b.fours) || 0;
            p.bat.sixes += parseInt(b.sixes) || 0;
            if (String(b.outDesc).toLowerCase() !== 'not out' && b.outDesc) p.bat.outs++;

            // Batting points logic
            let runs = parseInt(b.runs) || 0;
            let balls = parseInt(b.balls) || 0;
            let mPts = runs / 10;
            mPts += (parseInt(b.fours) || 0) * 0.012 + (parseInt(b.sixes) || 0) * 0.016;
            if (balls >= 10) {
              let sr = (runs / balls) * 100;
              if (sr >= 200) mPts += 0.05; else if (sr >= 150) mPts += 0.03; else if (sr < 100) mPts -= 0.05;
            }
            if (runs === 0 && balls > 0 && String(b.outDesc).toLowerCase() !== 'not out') mPts -= 0.15;
            p.pts += mPts;
          });

          (bowlers || []).forEach(b => {
            if (!players[b.name]) players[b.name] = {
              name: b.name, team: playerRealTeams[b.name] || bowlTeam,
              bat: { runs: 0, balls: 0, inn: 0, outs: 0, fours: 0, sixes: 0 },
              bowl: { wickets: 0, runs: 0, overs: 0, maidens: 0, inn: 0 },
              field: { catches: 0, runouts: 0, stumpings: 0 },
              pts: 0
            };
            let p = players[b.name];
            p.bowl.inn++;
            p.bowl.wickets += parseInt(b.wickets) || 0;
            p.bowl.runs += parseInt(b.runs) || 0;
            p.bowl.maidens += parseInt(b.maidens) || 0;
            p.bowl.overs = addTournamentOvers(p.bowl.overs, b.overs || 0);

            // Field stats aggregated in bowlers for now (matching app logic)
            p.field.catches += parseInt(b.catches) || 0;
            p.field.runouts += parseInt(b.run_outs) || 0;
            p.field.stumpings += parseInt(b.stumpings) || 0;

            // Bowling points logic
            let wickets = parseInt(b.wickets) || 0;
            let runsConceded = parseInt(b.runs) || 0;
            let oversFloat = parseFloat(b.overs) || 0;
            let totalBalls = (Math.floor(oversFloat) * 6) + Math.round((oversFloat % 1) * 10);
            let mPts = wickets * 1.33 + (parseInt(b.maidens) || 0) * 0.25;
            if (totalBalls >= 6) {
              let eco = runsConceded / (totalBalls / 6);
              if (eco <= 5) mPts += 0.25; else if (eco <= 6) mPts += 0.15; else if (eco <= 7) mPts += 0.05; else if (eco >= 10) mPts -= 0.1;
            }
            // Field points (approximate)
            mPts += (parseInt(b.catches) || 0) * 0.1 + (parseInt(b.run_outs) || 0) * 0.1 + (parseInt(b.stumpings) || 0) * 0.1;

            p.pts += mPts;
          });
        };

        if (m.innings1) {
          processInning(m.innings1.batsmen, m.innings1.bowlers, m.innings1.batTeam, m.innings1.bowlTeam);
          let b2 = m.innings2 ? m.innings2.batsmen : m.batsmen;
          let w2 = m.innings2 ? m.innings2.bowlers : m.bowlers;
          let tBat2 = m.innings2 ? m.innings2.batTeam : m.bowlTeam;
          let tBowl2 = m.innings2 ? m.innings2.bowlTeam : m.batTeam;
          processInning(b2, w2, tBat2, tBowl2);
        } else {
          processInning(m.batsmen, m.bowlers, m.batTeam, m.bowlTeam);
        }
      });

      // Sort and Render
      let playerList = Object.values(players);
      if (category === 'bat') {
        playerList = playerList.filter(p => p.bat.inn > 0).sort((a, b) => b.bat.runs - a.bat.runs);
      } else if (category === 'bowl') {
        playerList = playerList.filter(p => p.bowl.inn > 0).sort((a, b) => b.bowl.wickets - a.bowl.wickets);
      } else if (category === 'field') {
        playerList = playerList.filter(p => (p.field.catches + p.field.runouts + p.field.stumpings) > 0)
          .sort((a, b) => (b.field.catches + b.field.runouts + b.field.stumpings) - (a.field.catches + a.field.runouts + a.field.stumpings));
      } else if (category === 'mvp') {
        playerList.sort((a, b) => b.pts - a.pts);
      }

      if (playerList.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="td-empty-state"><div class="td-empty-text">No data available for this category yet.</div></div>`;
        return;
      }

      let html = '';
      playerList.forEach((p, i) => {
        let rank = (i + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0');
        let photoSrc = localStorage.getItem("userPhoto_" + p.name);
        let photoHtml = photoSrc ? `<img src="${photoSrc}" style="width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; border-radius:50%;">` : `<div style="width:100%; height:100%; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:20px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.3);">👤</div>`;

        let statsHtml = '';
        if (category === 'bat') {
          let avg = p.bat.outs > 0 ? (p.bat.runs / p.bat.outs).toFixed(2) : p.bat.runs.toFixed(2);
          let sr = p.bat.balls > 0 ? ((p.bat.runs / p.bat.balls) * 100).toFixed(2) : "0.00";
          statsHtml = `Inn: ${p.bat.inn.toString().padStart(2, '0')} | Runs: ${p.bat.runs} | Avg: ${avg} | SR: ${sr}`;
        } else if (category === 'bowl') {
          let totalBalls = Math.floor(p.bowl.overs) * 6 + Math.round((p.bowl.overs % 1) * 10);
          let eco = totalBalls >= 6 ? (p.bowl.runs / (totalBalls / 6)).toFixed(2) : "0.00";
          statsHtml = `Inn: ${p.bowl.inn.toString().padStart(2, '0')} | Wkts: ${p.bowl.wickets} | Runs: ${p.bowl.runs} | Eco: ${eco}`;
        } else if (category === 'field') {
          statsHtml = `Catches: ${p.field.catches} | Run Outs: ${p.field.runouts} | Stumpings: ${p.field.stumpings}`;
        } else if (category === 'mvp') {
          statsHtml = `Points: ${p.pts.toFixed(3)} | Matches: ${p.bat.inn + p.bowl.inn}`;
        }

        html += `
          <div style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius:12px; padding:16px; margin-bottom:12px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; backdrop-filter:blur(10px);">
            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; flex:1;">
              <div style="width:54px; height:54px; flex-shrink:0; border:2px solid rgba(110,231,183,0.2); border-radius:50%; padding:2px;">
                ${photoHtml}
              </div>
              <div style="flex:1;">
                <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif; font-size:17px; font-weight:700; color:#ffffff; line-height:1.2;">
                  ${p.name} <span style="font-weight:500; font-size:13px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.35); font-style:italic;">(${p.team})</span>
                </div>
                <div style="font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; font-size:12px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55); margin-top:5px; letter-spacing:0.2px;">
                  ${statsHtml}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif; font-size:24px; font-weight:800; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); margin-left:16px;">
              #${rank}
            </div>
          </div>`;
      });
      container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    async function loadMyTournaments() {
      let container = document.getElementById("myTournamentsContainer");
      if (!container) return;

      container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:60px 20px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);font-family:Inter,sans-serif;font-size:14px;">⏳ Loading tournaments...</div>';

      let user = (localStorage.getItem("currentUser") || '').trim();
      if (!user) {
        container.innerHTML = getEmptyStateHtml("Please log in to see your tournaments");
        return;
      }

      let myTourneys = [];
      try {
        // ✅ Fetch 1: Tournaments the user ORGANISED
        const orgRes = await fetch(API + '/tournaments/' + encodeURIComponent(user.toLowerCase()) + '?_t=' + Date.now());
        let orgTourneys = [];
        if (orgRes.ok) {
          const data = await orgRes.json();
          if (Array.isArray(data)) orgTourneys = data;
        }

        // ✅ Fetch 2: Tournaments the user is a PLAYER in
        const playerRes = await fetch(API + '/my-tournaments/' + encodeURIComponent(user) + '?_t=' + Date.now());
        let playerTourneys = [];
        if (playerRes.ok) {
          const data = await playerRes.json();
          if (Array.isArray(data)) playerTourneys = data;
        }

        // Merge both, deduplicate by id
        const seen = new Set();
        [...orgTourneys, ...playerTourneys].forEach(t => {
          if (!seen.has(t.id)) { seen.add(t.id); myTourneys.push(t); }
        });

        // Restore logos from localStorage if SQL doesn't have them
        let localTs = loadTournaments();
        myTourneys.forEach(sqlT => {
          let localMatch = localTs.find(lt => lt.name === sqlT.name);
          if (localMatch && localMatch.logo && !sqlT.logo) sqlT.logo = localMatch.logo;
        });

        // Update global tournaments array
        tournaments = myTourneys;

      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('loadMyTournaments error:', e);
        myTourneys = (tournaments || []).filter(t =>
          t.created_by === user || t.organiser === user || t.createdBy === user
        );
      }

      if (myTourneys.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = getEmptyStateHtml("No tournament found. You will see tournaments here once an organiser adds you to a team.");
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = myTourneys.map((t, i) => {
        let fmtDate = (d) => {
          if (!d) return '';
          let dt = new Date(d);
          if (isNaN(dt)) return d;
          return dt.getDate().toString().padStart(2, '0') + '-' + dt.toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'short' }) + '-' + dt.getFullYear().toString().substr(-2);
        };
        // Organiser photo from localStorage
        let organiserName = (t.created_by || t.organiser || '').trim();
        let orgPhoto = organiserName ? localStorage.getItem('userPhoto_' + organiserName) : null;
        let orgPhotoHtml = orgPhoto
          ? `<img src="${orgPhoto}" style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid rgba(110,231,183,0.5);" alt="Organiser">`
          : `<div style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(110,231,183,0.15);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;">👤</div>`;
        return `
      <div class="my-card" onclick="openTournamentDetailsBySQL(${t.id})" style="cursor:pointer;">
        <div class="tourney-card">
          <div class="tourney-img">
            ${t.logo
            ? `<img src="${t.logo}" alt="logo" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.parentNode.innerHTML='<div style=\\'font-size:32px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;height:100%;\\'>🏆</div>'">`
            : `<div style="font-size:32px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; height:100%; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0d9488,#1e3a5f);">🏏</div>`
          }
          </div>
          <div class="tourney-info">
            <div class="tourney-status-ongoing">Ongoing</div>
            <div class="tourney-name">${t.name}</div>
            <div class="tourney-dates">${fmtDate(t.startDate)} To ${fmtDate(t.endDate)}</div>
            <div class="tourney-loc">${t.city || ''}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

      }).join('');
    }

    async function updateAllPlayerStatsAfterMatch(inningsNum) {
      const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
      if (inningsNum === 2 && Object.keys(innings1BatStats).length > 0) {
        const sortedI1BatKeys = Object.keys(innings1BatStats).sort((a, b) => {
          let orderA = innings1BatStats[a].batOrder || Infinity;
          let orderB = innings1BatStats[b].batOrder || Infinity;
          if (orderA !== orderB) return orderA - orderB;
          return a.localeCompare(b);
        });
        for (let p of sortedI1BatKeys) {
          let s = innings1BatStats[p];
          try {
            await fetch(API + "/player-stats", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
              body: JSON.stringify({
                player_name: p, team_name: innings1BatTeam, opponent_team: innings1BowlTeam,
                match_date: today, match_type: "bat", runs: s.runs, balls_faced: s.balls,
                fours: s.fours, sixes: s.sixes, dismissal_type: s.dismissal_type || null,
                dismissed_by: (s.dismissed_by && s.dismissed_by_bowler ? s.dismissed_by + " b " + s.dismissed_by_bowler : s.dismissed_by) || null,
                match_id: currentMatchId, innings: 1
              })
            });
          } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
        }
        const sortedI1BowlKeys = Object.keys(innings1BowlStats).sort((a, b) => {
          let orderA = innings1BowlStats[a].bowlOrder || Infinity;
          let orderB = innings1BowlStats[b].bowlOrder || Infinity;
          if (orderA !== orderB) return orderA - orderB;
          return a.localeCompare(b);
        });
        for (let p of sortedI1BowlKeys) {
          let s = innings1BowlStats[p];
          try {
            await fetch(API + "/player-stats", {
              method: "POST",
              headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
              body: JSON.stringify({
                player_name: p, team_name: innings1BowlTeam, opponent_team: innings1BatTeam,
                match_date: today, match_type: "bowl", wickets: s.wickets,
                overs_bowled: Math.floor(s.balls / 6) + "." + (s.balls % 6), runs_conceded: s.runs,
                catches: s.catches || 0, run_outs: s.run_outs || 0, stumpings: s.stumpings || 0,
                match_id: currentMatchId, innings: 1
              })
            });
          } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
        }
      }
      const sortedBatKeys = Object.keys(batsmanStats).sort((a, b) => {
        let orderA = batsmanStats[a].batOrder || Infinity;
        let orderB = batsmanStats[b].batOrder || Infinity;
        if (orderA !== orderB) return orderA - orderB;
        return a.localeCompare(b);
      });
      for (let p of sortedBatKeys) {
        let s = batsmanStats[p];
        try {
          await fetch(API + "/player-stats", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              player_name: p, team_name: matchBatTeam, opponent_team: matchBowlTeam,
              match_date: today, match_type: "bat", runs: s.runs, balls_faced: s.balls,
              fours: s.fours, sixes: s.sixes, dismissal_type: s.dismissal_type || null,
              dismissed_by: (s.dismissed_by && s.dismissed_by_bowler ? s.dismissed_by + " b " + s.dismissed_by_bowler : s.dismissed_by) || null,
              match_id: currentMatchId, innings: inningsNum,
              shot_types: s.shot_types ? s.shot_types.join(",") : null,
              wagon_wheel: s.wagon_wheel ? s.wagon_wheel.join(",") : null
            })
          });
        } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
      }
      const sortedBowlKeys = Object.keys(bowlerStats).sort((a, b) => {
        let orderA = bowlerStats[a].bowlOrder || Infinity;
        let orderB = bowlerStats[b].bowlOrder || Infinity;
        if (orderA !== orderB) return orderA - orderB;
        return a.localeCompare(b);
      });
      for (let p of sortedBowlKeys) {
        let s = bowlerStats[p];
        try {
          await fetch(API + "/player-stats", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              player_name: p, team_name: matchBowlTeam, opponent_team: matchBatTeam,
              match_date: today, match_type: "bowl", wickets: s.wickets,
              overs_bowled: Math.floor(s.balls / 6) + "." + (s.balls % 6), runs_conceded: s.runs,
              catches: s.catches || 0, run_outs: s.run_outs || 0, stumpings: s.stumpings || 0,
              match_id: currentMatchId, innings: inningsNum
            })
          });
        } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
      }

      // Trigger background sync to Firebase for all participating players!
      let playersToSync = new Set();
      for (let p in batsmanStats) playersToSync.add(p);
      for (let p in bowlerStats) playersToSync.add(p);
      if (inningsNum === 2 && Object.keys(innings1BatStats).length > 0) {
        for (let p in innings1BatStats) playersToSync.add(p);
        for (let p in innings1BowlStats) playersToSync.add(p);
      }
      playersToSync.forEach(p => {
        syncPlayerProfileToFirebase(p).catch(err => console.error("Error syncing profile after match for " + p, err));
      });
    }

        let playerTeam = null;
        if (m.player_stats && m.player_stats.length > 0) {

        let tName = playerTeam || m.team_name;

    function formatOvers(balls) {
      if (typeof balls === 'string' && balls.includes('.')) return balls;
      const b = parseInt(balls) || 0;
      return Math.floor(b / 6) + "." + (b % 6);
    }

    function getMatchResult() {
      let winner = "", loser = "", margin = "";
      if (innings == 1) {
        winner = matchBowlTeam; loser = matchBatTeam;
        margin = "Match ended in 1st innings";
      } else {
        if (totalRuns >= target) {
          winner = matchBatTeam; loser = matchBowlTeam;
          margin = (10 - totalWickets) + " wickets";
        } else if (totalWickets >= 10 || (totalOvers > 0 && ballCount >= totalOvers * 6)) {
          winner = matchBowlTeam; loser = matchBatTeam;
          margin = (target - 1 - totalRuns) + " runs";
        } else if (totalRuns === target - 1 && (totalWickets >= 10 || (totalOvers > 0 && ballCount >= totalOvers * 6))) {
          winner = "Match Tied"; margin = "Tied";
        }
      }
      return { winner, loser, margin, text: winner === "Match Tied" ? "Match Tied" : `${winner} won by ${margin}` };
    }

    async function syncPlayerProfileToFirebase(playerName) {
      if (!window.fbSetDoc || !window.fbDb) return;
      try {
        const rRes = await fetch(API + "/player-role/" + encodeURIComponent(playerName));
        const rData = await rRes.json();
        let displayRole = rData.role || "Player";
        let batStyle = rData.batting_style || "";
        let bowlStyle = rData.bowling_style || "";

        let photoUrl = "";
        try {
          const photoRes = await fetch(API + "/player-photo/" + encodeURIComponent(playerName));
          const photoData = await photoRes.json();
          photoUrl = photoData.photo_url || "";
        } catch (e) { }

        let matchHistory = [];
        try {
          const res = await fetch(API + "/player-match-history/" + encodeURIComponent(playerName), { cache: "no-store" });
          matchHistory = await res.json();
        } catch (e) { }

        let teams = [];
        try {
          const teamsRes = await fetch(API + "/player-teams/" + encodeURIComponent(playerName));
          teams = await teamsRes.json();
        } catch (e) { }

        let profileData = {
          playerName: playerName,
          role: displayRole,
          batting_style: batStyle,
          bowling_style: bowlStyle,
          photo_url: photoUrl,
          teams: teams,
          matchHistory: matchHistory,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        };

        await window.fbSetDoc(window.fbDoc(window.fbDb, "player_profiles", playerName.trim().toLowerCase()), profileData);
        console.log("Synced player profile to Firebase:", playerName);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Error syncing player profile to Firebase:", e);
      }
    }

    function processRun(r, shotType, wagonZone) {
      if (r === 4 || r === 6) showEventPopup('boundary', { runs: r });
      let s = strike.value, n = nonstrike.value, b = bowler.value;
      if (!s || s === "") { alert("Please select a Striker first!"); return; }
      if (!n || n === "") { alert("Please select a Non-Striker first!"); return; }
      if (!batsmanStats[s]) batsmanStats[s] = { runs: 0, balls: 0, fours: 0, sixes: 0 };
      if (!bowlerStats[b]) bowlerStats[b] = { runs: 0, balls: 0, wickets: 0, dots: 0, fours: 0, sixes: 0, wides: 0, noballs: 0 };

      totalRuns += r; ballCount++;
      batsmanStats[s].runs += r; batsmanStats[s].balls++;

      if (r == 4) batsmanStats[s].fours++;
      if (r == 6) batsmanStats[s].sixes++;
      bowlerStats[b].runs += r; bowlerStats[b].balls++;
      if (r === 0) bowlerStats[b].dots = (bowlerStats[b].dots || 0) + 1;
      if (r === 4) bowlerStats[b].fours = (bowlerStats[b].fours || 0) + 1;
      if (r === 6) bowlerStats[b].sixes = (bowlerStats[b].sixes || 0) + 1;
      if (!batsmanStats[s].shot_types) batsmanStats[s].shot_types = [];
      if (!batsmanStats[s].wagon_wheel) batsmanStats[s].wagon_wheel = [];
      if (shotType) batsmanStats[s].shot_types.push(shotType);
      if (wagonZone) batsmanStats[s].wagon_wheel.push(wagonZone + ":" + r);

      // Commentary
      let over = Math.floor((ballCount - 1) / 6) + "." + ((ballCount - 1) % 6 + 1);
      matchCommentary.unshift({
        innings: innings, over: over, ball: r,
        text: `${b} to ${s}, ${r} run${r == 1 ? '' : 's'}${shotType ? ', ' + shotType : ''}`
      });

      addBall(r);
      if (r % 2 == 1) changeStrike();
      if (ballCount % 6 == 0) {
        // Over summary
        matchCommentary.unshift({
          innings: innings,
          type: "over_summary",
          over: Math.floor(ballCount / 6),
          runs: totalRuns,
          wkts: totalWickets,
          batters: [
            { name: strike.value, runs: batsmanStats[strike.value].runs, balls: batsmanStats[strike.value].balls },
            { name: nonstrike.value, runs: batsmanStats[nonstrike.value].runs, balls: batsmanStats[nonstrike.value].balls }
          ],
          bowler: { name: b, stats: `${Math.floor(bowlerStats[b].balls / 6)}.${bowlerStats[b].balls % 6} - ${bowlerStats[b].maidens || 0} - ${bowlerStats[b].runs} - ${bowlerStats[b].wickets} (0s:${bowlerStats[b].dots || 0})` }
        });

        changeStrike();
        if (totalOvers > 0 && ballCount >= totalOvers * 6) {
          alert("All " + totalOvers + " overs complete! Innings ended.");
        } else {
          setTimeout(openBowlerChangePopup, 300);
        }
      }
      updateScore(); updateTables();
      updateLiveScore();
    }

    function confirmWicket() {
      showEventPopup('wicket', {});
      let outPlayer = document.getElementById("wicketPlayerSelect").value;
      let dismissalType = document.getElementById("dismissalTypeSelect").value;
      let dismissedBy = dismissalType === "Bowled" ? bowler.value : document.getElementById("dismissedBySelect").value;
      let dismissedBy2 = (dismissalType === "Run Out") ? document.getElementById("dismissedBySelect2").value : "";
      let extraRuns = window._wicketExtraRuns || 0;

      document.getElementById("wicketOverlay").classList.remove("open");

        bowlerStats[bowler.value].runs += extraRuns;

      totalWickets++; ballCount++;
      let ballStr = extraRuns > 0 ? extraRuns + "+W" : "W";
      addBall(ballStr);
      if (dismissalType !== "Run Out") {
        bowlerStats[bowler.value].wickets++;

        batsmanStats[outPlayer].dismissed_by_bowler = bowler.value;
      }
      outBatsmen.push(outPlayer);
      if (dismissalType === "Caught" && dismissedBy) {
        if (!bowlerStats[dismissedBy]) bowlerStats[dismissedBy] = { runs: 0, balls: 0, wickets: 0, catches: 0, run_outs: 0, stumpings: 0 };
        bowlerStats[dismissedBy].catches = (bowlerStats[dismissedBy].catches || 0) + 1;
      } else if (dismissalType === "Run Out" && dismissedBy) {
        if (!bowlerStats[dismissedBy]) bowlerStats[dismissedBy] = { runs: 0, balls: 0, wickets: 0, catches: 0, run_outs: 0, stumpings: 0 };
        bowlerStats[dismissedBy].run_outs = (bowlerStats[dismissedBy].run_outs || 0) + 1;

        if (dismissedBy2 && dismissedBy2 !== dismissedBy) {
          if (!bowlerStats[dismissedBy2]) bowlerStats[dismissedBy2] = { runs: 0, balls: 0, wickets: 0, catches: 0, run_outs: 0, stumpings: 0 };
          bowlerStats[dismissedBy2].run_outs = (bowlerStats[dismissedBy2].run_outs || 0) + 1;
        }
      } else if (dismissalType === "Stumped" && dismissedBy) {

    function updateScore() {

          })
        });
        let data = await res.json();
        currentMatchId = data.id || null;
      } catch (e) { console.error("Save match result error:", e); currentMatchId = null; }

      // Legacy points table update (for global standings)
      let winnerRuns = totalRuns, winnerOvers = parseFloat(Math.floor(ballCount / 6) + "." + (ballCount % 6));
      let loserRuns = target > 0 ? target - 1 : 0, loserOvers = parseFloat(Math.floor(totalOvers * 6 / 6) + "." + 0);

    function buildScorecard(winner, loser, stats) {
      function batTable(players) {
        if (!players || players.length === 0) return "<div style='color:#4b5563;font-size:12px;padding:6px;'>No data</div>";
        let totalRuns = players.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.runs || 0), 0);
        let totalWkts = players.filter(p => p.dismissal_type).length;
        let html = '<table style="width:100%;font-size:12px;"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left;">Batter</th><th>R</th><th>B</th><th>4s</th><th>6s</th><th>SR</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
        players.forEach(p => {
          let sr = p.balls_faced > 0 ? ((p.runs / p.balls_faced) * 100).toFixed(1) : "0.0";
          let dismissal = "not out";
          if (p.dismissal_type === "Bowled") dismissal = "b " + (p.dismissed_by || "");
          else if (p.dismissal_type === "Caught") dismissal = "c & b " + (p.dismissed_by || "");
          else if (p.dismissal_type === "Run Out") dismissal = "run out (" + (p.dismissed_by || "") + ")";
          else if (p.dismissal_type === "Stumped") dismissal = "st " + (p.dismissed_by || "");
          html += `<tr><td style="text-align:left;"><div style="font-weight:600;">${p.player_name}</div><div style="font-size:10px;color:#9ca3af;">${dismissal}</div></td><td style="font-weight:700;color:#6ee7b7;">${p.runs}</td><td>${p.balls_faced}</td><td>${p.fours}</td><td>${p.sixes}</td><td style="color:#93c5fd;">${sr}</td></tr>`;
        });
        html += `</tbody></table><div style="font-size:12px;color:#a7f3d0;padding:6px 0;font-weight:700;">Total: ${totalRuns}/${totalWkts}</div>`;
        return html;
      }
      function bowlTable(players) {
        if (!players || players.length === 0) return "<div style='color:#4b5563;font-size:12px;padding:6px;'>No data</div>";
        let html = '<table style="width:100%;font-size:12px;"><thead><tr><th style="text-align:left;">Bowler</th><th>O</th><th>R</th><th>W</th><th>Eco</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
        players.forEach(p => {
          let eco = p.overs_bowled && p.overs_bowled !== "0.0" ? (p.runs_conceded / parseFloat(p.overs_bowled)).toFixed(2) : "0.00";
          html += `<tr><td style="text-align:left;font-weight:600;">${p.player_name}</td><td>${p.overs_bowled}</td><td>${p.runs_conceded}</td><td style="font-weight:700;color:${p.wickets > 0 ? '#6ee7b7' : '#e5e7eb'};">${p.wickets}</td><td style="color:#93c5fd;">${eco}</td></tr>`;
        });
        html += '</tbody></table>';
        return html;
      }
      let inn1bat = stats.filter(s => s.innings == 1 && s.match_type === "bat");
      let inn1bowl = stats.filter(s => s.innings == 1 && s.match_type === "bowl");
      let inn2bat = stats.filter(s => s.innings == 2 && s.match_type === "bat");
      let inn2bowl = stats.filter(s => s.innings == 2 && s.match_type === "bowl");
      let inn1batTeam = inn1bat.length > 0 ? inn1bat[0].team_name : winner;
      let inn2batTeam = inn2bat.length > 0 ? inn2bat[0].team_name : loser;
      return `<div style="background:rgba(37,99,235,0.1);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;margin-bottom:10px;"><div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#93c5fd;letter-spacing:1px;">1ST INNINGS</div></div>
    <div class="finished-team-title">🏏 ${inn1batTeam} Batting</div>${batTable(inn1bat)}
    <div class="finished-team-title" style="margin-top:10px;">🎳 Bowling</div>${bowlTable(inn1bowl)}
    <div style="background:rgba(22,163,74,0.1);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;margin:14px 0 10px;"><div style="font-family:'Rajdhani',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#6ee7b7;letter-spacing:1px;">2ND INNINGS</div></div>
    <div class="finished-team-title">🏏 ${inn2batTeam} Batting</div>${batTable(inn2bat)}
    <div class="finished-team-title" style="margin-top:10px;">🎳 Bowling</div>${bowlTable(inn2bowl)}`;
    }

        document.getElementById("pointsTableBody").innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="color:#4b5563;text-align:center;padding:20px;">No tournaments found. Create a tournament first.</td></tr>';

        selectorArea = div;
      }
      selectorArea.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px;">' +
        '<label style="font-family:\'Rajdhani\',sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:#6ee7b7;font-weight:600;">Select Tournament:</label>' +
        '<select id="pointsTournamentSelect" onchange="loadPointsTable()" style="padding:9px 14px;background:#1f2937;border:1px solid rgba(110,231,183,0.3);border-radius:8px;color:#e5e7eb;font-family:\'Rajdhani\',sans-serif;font-size:14px;outline:none;">' +
        allTournaments.map((t, i) => '<option value="' + i + '">' + t.name + '</option>').join('') +
        '</select></div>';

      let selEl = document.getElementById("pointsTournamentSelect");
      let tIdx = selEl ? parseInt(selEl.value) : 0;
      let t = allTournaments[tIdx];


      let tbody = document.getElementById("pointsTableBody");
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center;padding:20px;color:#6ee7b7;">⏳ Loading SQL Standings...</td></tr>';

      // Professional NRR Calculation Logic
      let tournamentMatches = [];
      try {
        const res = await fetch(API + "/tournament-matches/" + t.id + "?_t=" + Date.now());
        tournamentMatches = await res.json();
      } catch (e) { tournamentMatches = t.matches || []; }

      let teamStats = {};
      (t.teams || []).forEach(team => {
        teamStats[team.name] = { M: 0, W: 0, L: 0, Pts: 0, runsScored: 0, oversFaced: 0, runsConceded: 0, oversBowled: 0, nrr: 0 };
      });

      tournamentMatches.filter(m => m.status === 'finished' || m.status === 'completed' || (m.result && m.result !== 'LIVE')).forEach(m => {
        let winner = "", loser = "";
        let winnerMatch = (m.result || "").match(/^(.+?) won/);
        if (winnerMatch) {
          winner = winnerMatch[1].trim();
          loser = (winner === m.team1) ? m.team2 : m.team1;
        } else if (parseInt(m.score1) > parseInt(m.score2)) {
          winner = m.team1; loser = m.team2;
        } else if (parseInt(m.score2) > parseInt(m.score1)) {
          winner = m.team2; loser = m.team1;
        } else return;

        let mWinner = winner.toLowerCase().trim();
        let mLoser = loser.toLowerCase().trim();

        // Find correct keys in teamStats (case-insensitive)
        let winnerKey = Object.keys(teamStats).find(k => k.toLowerCase().trim() === mWinner);
        let loserKey = Object.keys(teamStats).find(k => k.toLowerCase().trim() === mLoser);

        if (!winnerKey) { teamStats[winner] = { M: 0, W: 0, L: 0, Pts: 0, runsScored: 0, oversFaced: 0, runsConceded: 0, oversBowled: 0, nrr: 0 }; winnerKey = winner; }
        if (!loserKey) { teamStats[loser] = { M: 0, W: 0, L: 0, Pts: 0, runsScored: 0, oversFaced: 0, runsConceded: 0, oversBowled: 0, nrr: 0 }; loserKey = loser; }

        teamStats[winnerKey].M++; teamStats[winnerKey].W++; teamStats[winnerKey].Pts += 2;
        teamStats[loserKey].M++; teamStats[loserKey].L++;

        // NRR Data from Joined SQL
        let r1 = parseInt(m.t1_score) || 0;
        let r2 = parseInt(m.t2_score) || 0;
        let ov1 = parseFloat(m.t1_overs) || 0;
        let ov2 = parseFloat(m.t2_overs) || 0;

        if (mWinner === (m.team1 || "").toLowerCase().trim()) {
          teamStats[winnerKey].runsScored += r1; teamStats[winnerKey].oversFaced += ov1;
          teamStats[winnerKey].runsConceded += r2; teamStats[winnerKey].oversBowled += ov2;
          teamStats[loserKey].runsScored += r2; teamStats[loserKey].oversFaced += ov2;
          teamStats[loserKey].runsConceded += r1; teamStats[loserKey].oversBowled += ov1;
        } else {
          teamStats[winnerKey].runsScored += r2; teamStats[winnerKey].oversFaced += ov2;
          teamStats[winnerKey].runsConceded += r1; teamStats[winnerKey].oversBowled += ov1;
          teamStats[loserKey].runsScored += r1; teamStats[loserKey].oversFaced += ov1;
          teamStats[loserKey].runsConceded += r2; teamStats[loserKey].oversBowled += ov2;
        }
      });

      Object.keys(teamStats).forEach(name => {
        let s = teamStats[name];
        function toBalls(ov) { return Math.floor(ov) * 6 + Math.round((ov % 1) * 10); }
        let bFaced = toBalls(s.oversFaced);
        let bBowled = toBalls(s.oversBowled);
        let rrS = bFaced > 0 ? (s.runsScored / (bFaced / 6)) : 0;
        let rrC = bBowled > 0 ? (s.runsConceded / (bBowled / 6)) : 0;
        s.nrr = (rrS - rrC).toFixed(3);
      });

      let rows = Object.entries(teamStats).sort((a, b) => b[1].Pts - a[1].Pts || parseFloat(b[1].nrr) - parseFloat(a[1].nrr));

      if (rows.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="color:#4b5563;text-align:center;padding:20px;">No teams or matches yet.</td></tr>';
        return;
      }

      tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(([name, s], i) => `
        <tr>
          <td>${i + 1}</td>
          <td style="color:#f8fafc; font-weight:700;">${name} ${i === 0 ? '👑' : ''}</td>
          <td>${s.M}</td>
          <td>${s.W}</td>
          <td>${s.L}</td>
          <td style="color:#6ee7b7; font-weight:800;">${s.Pts}</td>
          <td style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px;">${s.nrr > 0 ? '+' : ''}${s.nrr}</td>
          <td>
            <button onclick="deleteTeamFromPoints('${escapeQ(name)}', ${t.id})" style="background:rgba(220,38,38,0.15);border:1px solid rgba(220,38,38,0.3);color:#f87171;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:5px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;">❌</button>

          </td>
        </tr>
      `).join('');
    }

    }

    async function finishMatch() {
      if (winShown) return;
      let res = getMatchResult();
      let winner = res.winner, loser = res.loser, margin = res.margin, finalResult = res.text;
      let inningsNum = innings;
      winShown = true;

      let tId = (currentViewingTournament ? currentViewingTournament.id : null);
      saveMatchResult(winner, loser, "won", margin, currentTournamentMatchIdx, tId, matchTossText).then(() => {
        updateAllPlayerStatsAfterMatch(inningsNum);
        finishLiveMatch(finalResult);
      });


      // Update tournament match result in SQL if it exists
      if (currentTournamentMatchIdx !== null && !isNaN(currentTournamentMatchIdx)) {
        try {
          await fetch(API + "/tournament-matches/" + currentTournamentMatchIdx, {
            method: "PATCH",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ status: "finished", result: finalResult })
          });
        } catch (e) { console.warn("Failed to update tournament match to finished:", e); }
      }

      // Consolidated MOM Calculation
      let players = {};
      const getP = (n) => {
        if (!players[n]) players[n] = { runs: 0, balls: 0, fours: 0, sixes: 0, wickets: 0, dots: 0, maidens: 0, bRuns: 0, bBalls: 0, catches: 0, run_outs: 0, stumpings: 0 };
        return players[n];
      };
      for (let p in batsmanStats) { let s = getP(p); s.runs += batsmanStats[p].runs; s.balls += batsmanStats[p].balls; s.fours += batsmanStats[p].fours; s.sixes += batsmanStats[p].sixes; }
      for (let p in innings1BatStats) { let s = getP(p); s.runs += innings1BatStats[p].runs; s.balls += innings1BatStats[p].balls; s.fours += (innings1BatStats[p].fours || 0); s.sixes += (innings1BatStats[p].sixes || 0); }
      for (let p in bowlerStats) { let s = getP(p); s.wickets += bowlerStats[p].wickets; s.bRuns += bowlerStats[p].runs; s.bBalls += bowlerStats[p].balls; s.dots += (bowlerStats[p].dots || 0); s.maidens += (bowlerStats[p].maidens || 0); s.catches += (bowlerStats[p].catches || 0); s.run_outs += (bowlerStats[p].run_outs || 0); s.stumpings += (bowlerStats[p].stumpings || 0); }
      for (let p in innings1BowlStats) { let s = getP(p); s.wickets += innings1BowlStats[p].wickets; s.bRuns += innings1BowlStats[p].runs; s.bBalls += innings1BowlStats[p].balls; s.dots += (innings1BowlStats[p].dots || 0); s.maidens += (innings1BowlStats[p].maidens || 0); s.catches += (innings1BowlStats[p].catches || 0); s.run_outs += (innings1BowlStats[p].run_outs || 0); s.stumpings += (innings1BowlStats[p].stumpings || 0); }

      let mom = "N/A", momStats = "", momScore = -1;
      for (let n in players) {
        let p = players[n];
        let sr = p.balls > 0 ? (p.runs / p.balls) * 100 : 0;
        let eco = p.bBalls > 0 ? (p.bRuns / (p.bBalls / 6)) : 99;
        let score = (p.runs * 1) + (p.fours * 1) + (p.sixes * 2) + (p.wickets * 20) + (p.dots * 1) + (p.maidens * 10) + (p.catches * 10) + (p.run_outs * 10) + (p.stumpings * 10);
        if (sr > 150) score += 15; else if (sr > 120) score += 5;
        if (p.bBalls >= 12) { if (eco < 6) score += 15; else if (eco < 8) score += 5; }

        if (score > momScore) {
          momScore = score; mom = n;
          let parts = [];
          if (p.runs > 0) parts.push(`${p.runs} runs`);
          if (p.wickets > 0) parts.push(`${p.wickets} wkts`);
          if (p.catches + p.run_outs + p.stumpings > 0) parts.push(`${p.catches + p.run_outs + p.stumpings} field`);
          momStats = parts.join(", ");
        }
      }

      // Removed showEventPopup to use the old showWinPopup

      showWinPopup(winner, margin);
      // finishLiveMatch() moved to .then of saveMatchResult to avoid race condition with stats

    function openDateTimePicker(callback, initialVal) {
      dtpCallback = callback;

      dtpState.month = now.getMonth();

      let h = now.getHours();
      dtpState.ampm = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
      dtpState.hour = h % 12 || 12;
      dtpState.minute = Math.floor(now.getMinutes() / 5) * 5;

      dtpState.view = 'hour';
      renderDtCalendar();

    function changeDtMonth(dir) {
      dtpState.month += dir;
      if (dtpState.month < 0) { dtpState.month = 11; dtpState.year--; }
      if (dtpState.month > 11) { dtpState.month = 0; dtpState.year++; }
      renderDtCalendar();
    }

    function renderDtCalendar() {
      const months = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
      document.getElementById('dtpMonthYear').innerText = `${months[dtpState.month]} ${dtpState.year}`;

      grid.innerHTML = ['S', 'M', 'T', 'W', 'T', 'F', 'S'].map(d => `<div class="dtp-day-name">${d}</div>`).join('');

      const firstDay = new Date(dtpState.year, dtpState.month, 1).getDay();
      const daysInMonth = new Date(dtpState.year, dtpState.month + 1, 0).getDate();

      for (let i = 0; i < firstDay; i++) grid.innerHTML += '<div></div>';
      for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {

    function selectDtDay(d) {

    function switchDtClock(view) {
      dtpState.view = view;
      document.getElementById('dtpClockTitle').innerText = view === 'hour' ? 'Select Hour' : 'Select Minute';
      document.getElementById('dtpClockBackBtn').style.display = view === 'minute' ? 'block' : 'none';
      document.getElementById('dtpClockNextBtn').style.display = view === 'hour' ? 'block' : 'none';
      renderDtClock();
    }

    function renderDtClock() {
      const numbersContainer = document.getElementById('dtpClockNumbers');
      let html = '';
      let handAngle = 0;

      if (dtpState.view === 'hour') {
        for (let h = 1; h <= 12; h++) {
          const angle = (h * 30);
          const x = 75 * Math.sin(angle * Math.PI / 180);
          const y = -75 * Math.cos(angle * Math.PI / 180);
          const isSelected = h === dtpState.hour;
          html += `<div class="dtp-clock-number ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}" style="left:calc(50% + ${x}px - 14px); top:calc(50% + ${y}px - 14px);" onclick="selectDtHour(${h})" onmouseenter="hoverDtHour(${h})">${h}</div>`;
          if (isSelected) handAngle = angle;
        }
      } else {
        for (let m = 0; m < 60; m += 5) {
          const angle = (m * 6);
          const x = 75 * Math.sin(angle * Math.PI / 180);
          const y = -75 * Math.cos(angle * Math.PI / 180);
          const isSelected = m === dtpState.minute;
          const displayMin = m < 10 ? '0' + m : m;
          html += `<div class="dtp-clock-number ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}" style="left:calc(50% + ${x}px - 14px); top:calc(50% + ${y}px - 14px);" onclick="selectDtMin(${m})" onmouseenter="hoverDtMin(${m})">${displayMin}</div>`;
          if (isSelected) handAngle = angle;
        }
      }

      numbersContainer.innerHTML = html;
      document.getElementById('dtpClockHand').style.transform = `rotate(${handAngle}deg)`;
    }

    }

    function hoverDtMin(m) {

    function resetDtHand() {

    // --- Dragging Logic ---
    let dtpIsDragging = false;
    function initDtClockEvents() {
      const face = document.getElementById('dtpClockFace');
      face.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => { dtpIsDragging = true; handleDtClockInteraction(e); });
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => { if (dtpIsDragging) handleDtClockInteraction(e); });
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { dtpIsDragging = false; });

      face.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { dtpIsDragging = true; handleDtClockInteraction(e.touches[0]); e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
      window.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => { if (dtpIsDragging) handleDtClockInteraction(e.touches[0]); }, { passive: false });
      window.addEventListener('touchend', () => { dtpIsDragging = false; });
    }

    function handleDtClockInteraction(e) {
      const face = document.getElementById('dtpClockFace');
      const rect = face.getBoundingClientRect();
      const cx = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
      const cy = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
      const dx = e.clientX - cx;
      const dy = e.clientY - cy;

      let angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx) * 180 / Math.PI + 90;
      if (angle < 0) angle += 360;

      if (dtpState.view === 'hour') {
        let h = Math.round(angle / 30);
        if (h === 0) h = 12;
        if (h > 12) h = 12;
        if (h !== dtpState.hour) {
          dtpState.hour = h;
          renderDtClock();
          updateDtCurrentVal();
        }
      } else {
        let m = Math.round(angle / 6) % 60;
        // Snap to 5 mins for now if desired, or allow every minute. 
        // CricHeroes usually snaps to 5 mins unless dragging. 
        // Let's allow every minute but highlight the numbers.
        if (m !== dtpState.minute) {
          dtpState.minute = m;
          renderDtClock();
          updateDtCurrentVal();
        }
      }
    }

    function updateDtCurrentVal() {
      const m = (dtpState.month + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0');
      const d = dtpState.day.toString().padStart(2, '0');
      const min = dtpState.minute.toString().padStart(2, '0');
      const val = `${m}/${d}/${dtpState.year} ${dtpState.hour}:${min} ${dtpState.ampm}`;
      document.getElementById('dtpCurrentVal').innerText = val;
    }

    // GLOBAL SWIPE TO SWITCH TABS
    (function () {
      let swipeStartX = 0;
      let swipeStartY = 0;

      document.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
        if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches.length > 0) {
          swipeStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
          swipeStartY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;
        }
      }, { passive: true });

      document.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
        if (!e.changedTouches || e.changedTouches.length === 0) return;
        const page = document.getElementById('globalScorecardPage');

        const swipeEndX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;
        const swipeEndY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;

        const diffX = swipeStartX - swipeEndX;
        const diffY = swipeStartY - swipeEndY;

        if (Math.abs(diffX) > 60 && Math.abs(diffX) > Math.abs(diffY) * 1.5) {

          let isScrollable = false;
          let target = e.target;
          while (target && target !== document.body) {
            const style = window.getComputedStyle(target);
            if (style.overflowX === 'auto' || style.overflowX === 'scroll' || target.tagName === 'CANVAS' || target.tagName === 'INPUT') {
              isScrollable = true;
              break;
            }
            target = target.parentNode;
          }

          if (isScrollable) return;

          // Find the tabs depending on which page is active
          let tabsNav = document.querySelector('.match-tabs-nav');
          let tabClass = '.match-tab-link';

          if (!page || page.style.display === 'none') {
            // Check if live match page is visible instead
            const livePage = document.getElementById('liveMatchPage');
            if (livePage && livePage.style.display !== 'none') {
              tabsNav = document.querySelector('.mt-tabs-container');
              tabClass = '.mt-tab';
            } else {
              return; // Neither page is active
            }
          }

          if (!tabsNav) return;

          const tabs = Array.from(tabsNav.querySelectorAll(tabClass));
          if (tabs.length === 0) return;

          const activeIndex = tabs.findIndex(t => t.classList.contains('active'));
          if (activeIndex === -1) return;

          if (diffX > 0) {
            if (activeIndex < tabs.length - 1) {
              tabs[activeIndex + 1].click();
              tabs[activeIndex + 1].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' });
            }
          } else {
            if (activeIndex > 0) {
              tabs[activeIndex - 1].click();
              tabs[activeIndex - 1].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' });
            }
          }
        }
      }, { passive: true });
    })();
  </script>

  <!-- Premium Event Popups Modal -->
  <div id="eventPopupModal" class="event-popup-overlay" onclick="closeEventPopup()">
    <div class="event-popup-box" id="eventPopupContent" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
      <!-- Content filled by JS -->
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    // Global Hover Tooltips logic
    document.addEventListener('mouseover', function (e) {
      let el = e.target.closest('button, span, div, a, i');
      if (!el) return;

      // If it's a cursor:pointer element or a button, and doesn't have a title
      if (!el.hasAttribute('title') && (el.tagName === 'BUTTON' || window.getComputedStyle(el).cursor === 'pointer')) {
        let html = el.innerHTML || '';
        let text = el.innerText ? el.innerText.trim() : '';
        let onclick = el.getAttribute('onclick') || '';
        let cls = el.className || '';

        // Avoid adding title to large containers
        if (el.offsetWidth > 300 || el.offsetHeight > 100) return;

        // Check for specific actions
        if (cls.includes('delete') || html.includes('❌') || html.includes('🗑️') || onclick.toLowerCase().includes('delete') || text.toLowerCase() === 'delete') {
          el.setAttribute('title', 'Delete');
        } else if (html.includes('✏️') || html.includes('✎') || html.includes('Edit') || onclick.toLowerCase().includes('edit') || text.toLowerCase() === 'edit') {
          el.setAttribute('title', 'Edit');
        } else if (html.includes('+ Player') || html.includes('👥') || text.toLowerCase().includes('add player')) {
          el.setAttribute('title', 'Add Player');
        } else if (text && text.length < 25 && !text.includes('\n')) {
          // Fallback to text content if it's short
          el.setAttribute('title', text);
        }
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>

</html>
